tooltip.relics_thirteenflames.knef_bow.l:
One of the «Flames», legendary artifacts scattered across the world.
Created by Knephmtyti, goddess of Death.
tooltip.relics.knef_bow.leveling:
+1 experience point for each «Moonlight Arrows» hit. 
 +1 experience point for each point of HP healed by «Heaven's Wrath».
tooltip.relics.knef_bow.ability.shot.des: Shoots out multiple beams of moonlight that track nearest targets. Each shot drains the user's HP.
tooltip.relics.knef_bow.ability.swim.des: If this ability is active, using the Bow while submerged or under the rain will send you forward with great speed, damaging enemies in your way.
tooltip.relics.knef_bow.ability.storm.de:
Holding down Shift while charging the shot and shooting the Arrow into the sky will summon an Eye of the Storm, that will send down thunder and rain, damaging targets below and healing the user. A shot into the ground will create a powerful discharge, striking enemies with chain lightning.
Cooldown: 30 seconds.
tooltip.relics_thirteenflames.ronas_swor:
One of the «Flames», legendary artifacts scattered across the world.
Created by Rhonas, god of War.
tooltip.relics.ronas_sword.leveling:
+1-3 experience points for each «Rhonas' Venom» stack on a slain enemy. 
 25% chance to get +1 experience point for each new «Rhonas' Venom» stack on a target.
Each swiping attack releases a wave of potent venom that seeps further into its targets with every additional hit. Attacking too fast poisons the user instead.
Pressing Shift+RMB with the Fang will create a toxic cloud, poisoning the enemies in its range.
tooltip.relics.ronas_sword.ability.anemi: You feel the poison running through your veins, reducing the amount of healing received from all sources and limiting your prowess with the Fang while the blade is in your inventory.
tooltip.relics_thirteenflames.montu_hamm:
One of the «Flames», legendary artifacts scattered across the world.
Created by Montu, god of Labor.
tooltip.relics.montu_hammer.leveling:
+1 experience point for every 25 blocks mined with the Hammer. 
 +1 experience point for each block of ore extracted with «Montu's Strike».
tooltip.relics.montu_hammer.ability.slap: Pressing Shift+RMB on a block will create a shockwave, causing all ores below to spit out onto the surface.
The power of the God of Labor allows you to tear through the Earth's crust with ease, expanding the mining area. Use Shift + Mouse Wheel to control the Hammer's might.
tooltip.relics_thirteenflames.seliaset_h:
One of the «Flames», legendary artifacts scattered across the world.
Created by Seliaset, goddess of Fertility.
tooltip.relics.seliaset_horn.leveling: +1 experience point for each enemy stunned by «Nature's Rhythm»
tooltip.relics.seliaset_horn.ability.air: Blow into the Horn to unleash a powerful wind current, pushing all enemies away from you. Holding Shift will reverse the effect, pulling them towards you
tooltip.relics.seliaset_horn.ability.blo: Unleashes multiple shockwaves around the caster, sending surrounding enemies flying and stunning them.
One of the «Flames», legendary artifacts scattered across the world.
Created by Knephmtyti, goddess of Death.
tooltip.relics.knef_rose.leveling:
+1 experience point for each bone consumed by «Ghostflame Protection».
+1 experience point for each time a «Living Flesh» attacks its target.
+1 experience point for each split by «Unholy Rebirth»
tooltip.relics.knef_rose.ability.undeath: The Rose's unnatural flame protects its owner, using bones of the undead as fuel. You can put bones into the flower's kiln by clicking on it with a stack of bones. While the flame burns, it will prevent any damage from reaching the Rose's owner, expending some of the bones instead. While in the Nether, the Rose slowly replenishes its fuel.
tooltip.relics.knef_rose.ability.living_: Any living creature killed by the Rose's owner has a chance to rise again as a lump of undead flesh, exploding in a suffocating cloud upon their inevitable second death.
tooltip.relics.knef_rose.ability.rot_spl: Remains, born of the Rose's powers have a chance to continue their life, splitting into multiple smaller lumps.
tooltip.relics_thirteenflames.seliaset_s:
One of the «Flames», legendary artifacts scattered across the world.
Created by Seliaset, goddess of Fertility.
tooltip.relics.seliaset_sun.leveling: +1 experience point for each crop grown by «Bountiful Light»
tooltip.relics.seliaset_sun.ability.leve: Place the Sun into the world to return it to its true form. While active the Sun speeds up the growth of any crops nearby and damages the Undead and other aggressive monsters.
tooltip.relics_thirteenflames.ronas_shie:
One of the «Flames», legendary artifacts scattered across the world.
Created by Rhonas, god of War.
tooltip.relics.ronas_shield.leveling:
+1 experience point for each point of damage blocked.
+1 experience point for each enemy knocked away with either «Lion's Rebuke» or «Furious Charge»
tooltip.relics.ronas_shield.ability.bloc: Raise the shield, blocking a part of enemies' damage and converting it to hunger damage.
tooltip.relics.ronas_shield.ability.rebu: The Shield accumulates blocked damage, charging up. Press LMB while guarding to release the stored energy, dealing damage and knocking enemies away.
tooltip.relics.ronas_shield.ability.char: Raise your shield up and charge forward, knocking away all enemies in your path.
